name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia VP vote 9 Dec
summary: Indonesia's assembly will pick a vice-president to replace Gibran in December; no G20 collapse or coup
state: Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly is preparing to elect a successor to Vice-President Gibran, who resigned in mid-November, with the session moved to 9 Dec (Metro TV). Coalition parties have left the choice of nominees to President Prabowo (Jakarta Post, 14 Nov), and the process follows the constitution. Searches on 23 Nov found no G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No G20 government is in acute political crisis. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for country-specific political risks.
rubric_hit: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month = Normal

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
drivers: Elections, government collapses, coups, emergency rule, mass protest movements.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
